breaking: speed (px per second) removed: CSS cannot measure the content; use duration (seconds per copy, default 20)
Copies are no longer added automatically: new prop repeat (default 2); one copy times (repeat - 1) must cover the container

how.en: Copies of the content and a CSS translate by one copy; a small client part eases playbackRate to 0 on hover (Web Animations API)
how.ru: Копии содержимого и CSS-сдвиг на одну копию; маленькая клиентская часть плавно гасит playbackRate при наведении (Web Animations API)
